_readme: Facts published by car park operators on their own websites, read by hand and recorded with the page URL and the date checked. Only what the page says; no guessed heights or fees. Re-check every few months: tariffs change. Match by carParkId (one-stop park_Id or osm:… id) or by matchNames.

entries.feeEN: Mon–Thu HK$24/hour; Fri–Sun & public holidays HK$26/hour. First hour free on entry after 5 pm; up to 3 hours free with electronic spending. 830 spaces on three levels; EV fast chargers at P1, medium chargers at P3, Tesla Superchargers at P1.
entries.feeTC: 星期一至四每小時 HK$24；星期五至日及公眾假期每小時 HK$26。下午 5 時後入場首小時免費；電子消費最多免泊 3 小時。三層共 830 個車位；P1 設快速充電器及 Tesla 超級充電站，P3 設中速充電器。

entries.feeEN: Mon–Fri 07:00–23:00 HK$18 per half hour, 23:00–07:00 HK$8 per half hour; Sat, Sun & public holidays 07:00–23:00 HK$19 per half hour, 23:00–07:00 HK$8 per half hour (minimum half hour). 700 spaces on 4 basement levels; hourly and monthly parking.
entries.feeTC: 星期一至五 07:00–23:00 每半小時 HK$18，23:00–07:00 每半小時 HK$8；星期六、日及公眾假期 07:00–23:00 每半小時 HK$19，23:00–07:00 每半小時 HK$8（最少收費半小時）。地庫 4 層共 700 個車位，設時租及月租。
entries.notesEN: Car park entrance and drop-off on Sharp Street East; exit on Canal Road East.
entries.notesTC: 停車場入口及落客處在霎東街；出口在堅拿道東。

matchNames: International Finance Centre Mall car park
國際金融中心商場停車場
entries.feeEN: General parking (effective 1 Nov 2022), Mon–Sun & public holidays: HK$32/hour 07:01–23:00, HK$18/hour 23:01–07:00. Valet parking HK$60/hour (minimum 1 hour), 10:00–02:00 daily. EV charging stations in both One ifc and Two ifc car parks.
entries.feeTC: 一般泊車（2022 年 11 月 1 日起）星期一至日及公眾假期：07:01–23:00 每小時 HK$32，23:01–07:00 每小時 HK$18。代客泊車每小時 HK$60（最少一小時），每日 10:00–02:00。一期及二期停車場均設電動車充電站。
entries.notesEN: Drop-off / pick-up area on Finance Street near the Two ifc car park entrance.
entries.notesTC: 上落客區在金融街二期停車場入口附近。

entries.feeEN: Mon–Thu (except public holidays) HK$30/hour; Fri–Sun & public holidays HK$41/hour. Day parking offer Mon–Fri HK$150 per period from 8 am. KLUB 11 member privileges apply.
entries.feeTC: 星期一至四（公眾假期除外）每小時 HK$30；星期五至日及公眾假期每小時 HK$41。星期一至五日泊優惠每節 HK$150（早上 8 時起）。KLUB 11 會員另有優惠。

matchNames: 美麗華廣場一期停車場
entries.feeEN: Hourly 7 am–11 pm: Mon–Thu HK$41, Fri–Sun & public holidays HK$43; 11 pm–7 am HK$16. Day park HK$200 (7 am–6:30 pm, Mon–Fri); night park HK$80 (11 pm–7 am). Minimum charge one hour. Rates effective 1 Jan 2026.
entries.feeTC: 時租早上 7 時至晚上 11 時：星期一至四 HK$41，星期五至日及公眾假期 HK$43；晚上 11 時至早上 7 時 HK$16。日泊 HK$200（星期一至五 7:00–18:30）；夜泊 HK$80（23:00–07:00）。最少收費一小時。2026 年 1 月 1 日起生效。

entries.nameTC: 海運大廈停車場（海港城 P5）
entries.feeEN: Ocean Terminal Car Park (P5): 07:00–22:59 HK$17 per 30 minutes; 23:00–06:59 HK$6 per 30 minutes. 30 EV charging facilities. Part of Harbour City.
entries.feeTC: 海運大廈停車場（P5）：07:00–22:59 每 30 分鐘 HK$17；23:00–06:59 每 30 分鐘 HK$6。設 30 個電動車充電設施。屬海港城。

entries.nameTC: 海港城 3 號碼頭停車場（P3）
entries.feeEN: Harbour City Pier 3 Car Park (P3): 07:00–22:59 HK$19 per 30 minutes; 23:00–06:59 HK$6 per 30 minutes. Harbour City also has Ocean Centre Car Park (P6) and The Gateway Car Park (P1) at HK$19 per 30 minutes daytime; part of P1 under refurbishment from 13 July 2026.
entries.feeTC: 海港城 3 號碼頭停車場（P3）：07:00–22:59 每 30 分鐘 HK$19；23:00–06:59 每 30 分鐘 HK$6。海港城另有海洋中心停車場（P6）及港威停車場（P1），日間每 30 分鐘 HK$19；P1 部分自 2026 年 7 月 13 日起翻新。
